title: Implement FT-003 Boss admin HTTP boundary
verify: All /api/admin/* routes resolve active Boss ActorContext before business logic and deny Engineer/Consultant/disabled actors with stable safe errors.
Admin Account create, disable, membership role, personnel list, Plant projection, and audit routes match the Boss Admin HTTP response shapes, statuses, filters, no-store behavior, and error catalog.
POST /api/admin/accounts never returns password material and maps duplicate normalized login separately from generic persistence failure.
Last-active-Boss disable/demotion attempts return ADMIN_LAST_BOSS_CONFLICT without mutation or audit writes.
GET /api/admin/plants uses persisted Farm/Plant/grant state for projection and does not redefine Plant lifecycle/access mutation semantics.
GET /api/admin/audit returns reverse-chronological safe summaries, validates cursors, and never exposes auth material or raw DB errors.
Generated OpenAPI includes the admin paths, request bodies, response models, UUIDs, timestamps, enums, query filters, and documented error statuses.
FT-003-BHV-003 is covered by executable evidence.
evidence_required: non-Boss denial and last-Boss guard evidence
safe response field and password exclusion evidence
constraints: Use the admin service from TASK-016; do not duplicate account/audit transaction logic in route handlers.
Admin routes must require active Boss ActorContext before business logic.
Plant lifecycle/access mutations remain on the canonical Plant HTTP routes; /api/admin/plants is a projection only.
Protected admin responses set Cache-Control: no-store and exclude passwords, password_hash, tokens, token hashes, cookies, auth headers, and raw DB errors.
Do not introduce PWA UI, frontend-only authorization, hosted identity, email delivery, or multi-Farm behavior.
invariants: Frontend visibility is never authorization; backend admin routes enforce ActorContext.
Admin audit is durable PostgreSQL/read-model authority and UI/admin display text is not agent context.
Secrets/auth material never enter API responses, logs, audit, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, agent context, or evidence.
verification_targets: Inspect generated OpenAPI for every /api/admin path and documented response/error model.
Inject duplicate-login and unrelated persistence failures through the HTTP boundary and prove safe distinct errors.
purpose: Expose the Boss admin backend surface through concrete protected HTTP routes without weakening the existing auth, Plant, audit, or redaction boundaries.
success_outcome: Boss can use /api/admin routes for personnel, direct Account creation, role changes, Plant projection, and audit reads, while non-Boss actors fail closed and responses/errors remain safe and contract-compliant.
anti_goals: No new Plant mutation semantics outside the Plant HTTP contract.
No raw password/hash/token fields in route responses or evidence.

forbidden_scope: duplicated Account/Membership/audit transaction logic in API handlers
stop_conditions: TASK-016-T3-FT-003-W1 is not done or its service contract is unstable.
Admin route implementation requires changing the public session or Plant HTTP contracts without design repair.
OpenAPI cannot represent the documented admin route shapes/statuses.
Authorization failures leak protected account, membership, Plant, password, or raw persistence details.
Diagnostics or evidence contain password, password_hash, session token, token hash, auth header, cookie, DSN credential, or raw SQL exception text.
